en: Conditioned by a non-wholesome, non-form-sphere state, a wholesome, formless-sphere state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are six; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition there are six.

Dependent on a non-wholesome, non-non-form-sphere state, an indeterminate, non-form-sphere state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are five; under predominance condition there are five; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition there are five.
